name: Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych "Staporków" Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych "Staporków" Spólka Akcyjna operates as a prime contractor, undertaking projects within the industrial, thermal, and professional energy sectors. The company provides a comprehensive array of air purification technologies, featuring sophisticated two-stage dust removal systems like multi-cyclone units and extensive cyclone battery setups. They also offer filtrobicyclones, specifically engineered to clear exhaust gas particulates primarily from coal-fired grate boilers, and supply specialized bag filters for energy generation plants. Moreover, ZUK implements advanced systems for flue gas purification through desulfurization and denitrification processes, alongside modernizing existing dust-extraction installations. Their product portfolio additionally encompasses various material handling systems, including different types of scraper conveyors (such as those for slag removal), screw conveyors, belt conveyors, suspended scraper conveyors, and specialized energy slag removers for the commercial power industry. ZUK manufactures diverse mechanical grates, comprising heavy-duty, lighter, and stepped grate stokers, as well as grates designed for the co-combustion of coal and biomass. The firm also fabricates a broad range of steel structures, including absorbers, storage silos, and various support frameworks, extending to panel and large-scale formwork systems for the construction industry. Furthermore, ZUK is adept at the construction and fabrication of heat exchangers, industrial reactors, scrubbers, and other absorbers. Their expertise covers building scraper conveyors, a variety of machines and devices, and architectural and industrial elements like spiral staircases, service platforms, safety barriers, ladders, moulders, reducers, and steel compensators. They also develop equipment for transporting bulk materials and provide structural supports for technological process lines and piping networks. Founded in 1738, Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych "Staporków" Spólka Akcyjna is based in Staporków, Poland.
